app_tagline: [తెలుగు] Speak your problem. We find your scheme.
consent_body: [తెలుగు] We collect only minimum details to match you with government schemes. Voice recordings are kept securely for 30 days and then automatically deleted. You can delete your data at any time from Settings.
mode_selection_title: [తెలుగు] How would you like to use Umeed?
mode_text_badge: [తెలుగు] For those who can read and type
mode_text_subtitle: [తెలుగు] Type your details in a familiar form.
mode_audio_prompt: [తెలుగు] Press the orange button to speak, or the blue button to type.
q_gender: [తెలుగు] Are you a woman, a man, or other?
q_state: [తెలుగు] Which state do you live in?
q_area: [తెలుగు] Do you live in a village or a city?
q_caste: [తెలుగు] Which category do you belong to? (General, OBC, SC, ST). You may skip this.
q_income: [తెలుగు] About how much does your family earn in a year?
q_occupation: [తెలుగు] What work do you do? (Farmer, student, laborer, homemaker, business, other)
q_disability: [తెలుగు] Do you have any disability? You may skip this.
q_family: [తెలుగు] How many people live in your family?
q_need: [తెలుగు] What kind of help do you need most? (Farming, education, health, housing, money, jobs)
caste_why: [తెలుగు] Certain government schemes provide special grants, subsidies, or reservations specifically for SC, ST, or OBC categories.
income_why: [తెలుగు] Many schemes are meant for families below specific income limits or BPL thresholds.
disability_why: [తెలుగు] Special pensions, assistive devices, and quotas exist for persons with disabilities.
handoff_title: [తెలుగు] Your recordings have reached a helper
handoff_desc: [తెలుగు] A trained civic helper is reviewing your voice responses to complete your profile.
busy_day_desc: [తెలుగు] Our helpers are currently busy. We have scheduled a confirmed callback slot for you tomorrow.
reminder_scheduled: [తెలుగు] We will send an SMS and notification 15 minutes before your slot.
profile_ready_notification: [తెలుగు] Your profile is ready! Tap to view your ranked schemes.
docs_locked_notice: [తెలుగు] Documents unlock after speaking to the Help Desk or choosing to skip.
skip_help_desk: [తెలుగు] I already understand, skip to documents
physical_office_address: [తెలుగు] Or visit nearby CSC / Gram Panchayat office
no_proxy_notice: [తెలుగు] Umeed does not submit applications on your behalf. We guide you to the official window.
delete_data_confirm: [తెలుగు] Are you sure? This will erase your profile and cached voice recordings immediately.
disclaimer: [తెలుగు] Disclaimer: Umeed is an informational and guidance tool. Final eligibility and approvals are decided solely by the respective government authority.
q_sector_focus: [te] Which area or sector do you need help in? (Finance, Agriculture, Health, Housing, Education, Jobs, Pension)
choose_gist_language: [te] In which language would you like your scheme summary and gist?
query_help_desk: [te] Have a question about this scheme? Ask the Help Desk
type_query_hint: [te] Type or speak your question for the helper...
